intent: Extract independent assets from approved originals; preserve source visual identity

assets.name: illustration-home-bento-v2.png
assets.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Asset type: isolated bento illustration from an APPROVED Japanese preschool cooking app. Image 1 is the edit target, the approved whole screen. Extract ONLY the abundant red bento box and ALL its food from the large left card; carefully preserve the exact original drawing, composition, texture, highlights, vibrant colors, food count and camera angle. Keep the front happy white triangular rice ball with black nori, eyes, pink cheeks and smiling mouth, back-left fried chicken, back-right rolled yellow omelette, green lettuce border, broccoli, red tomato, orange flower carrot. Show complete red box with a minimally completed lower rim where the green button had occluded it. No redesign. No new foods. No text, button, card, green background, cloud, sparkles, character, logo or shadow outside the object. True transparent alpha background. Landscape framing around 3:2 with small transparent margins, full object centered, not cropped. This asset will fit a 640x350 UI illustration slot.
assets.review: Abundant original food arrangement and face maintained. Transparent alpha sampling verified; some RGB outside alpha can look like a glow in tools that ignore transparency.
